landing.title: Help identify an unresponsive person
landing.body: Take one photo. Traya checks the image, searches enrolled records, and reaches the right people and hospital.
landing.steps.title: How it works
landing.features.title: What it does
landing.f1.title: Checks the photo first
landing.f1.body: Blur, darkness, distance and extra faces are caught before anything is searched, so a bad photo never becomes a wrong match.
landing.f2.title: Shows its reasoning
landing.f2.body: Every result carries the quality report, the match method and the runner-up, so a responder can judge it rather than trust it.
landing.f3.title: Reaches the right people
landing.f3.body: Medical details, emergency contacts and the nearest hospital are routed by role and permission, not shown to everyone.
landing.f4.title: Records who looked
landing.f4.body: Every view of an identity is written to the audit log, and the person can see their own access history.
landing.f5.title: Consent before capture
landing.f5.body: A face is only enrolled after explicit, withdrawable consent, stored encrypted and never returned to a device.
landing.f6.title: Works on any phone
landing.f6.body: Built mobile-first for the devices responders actually carry, in English and Tamil.

result.nomatch: No enrolled record matched this photo. A responder can still help.
result.next.label: What to do next
result.next.high: Check the name against the person in front of you. If it matches, send their medical alert.
result.next.confirmed: A responder has confirmed this match. Send the medical alert and notify the emergency contact.
result.next.review: The match is not certain. Confirm the identity with the person or a bystander before sharing any medical detail.
result.next.multiple: Several people look similar. Look at the photo and ask the bystander which one it is, then confirm.
result.next.low: We are not confident in this match. Ask for another photo in better light, or check the medical alert anyway if the person is in danger.
result.next.nomatch: This person is not enrolled, or the photo did not match. Treat them as unknown and follow normal emergency care.
result.next.retake: No face was found in the photo. Take it again with one face filling the frame.
result.next.multiplefaces: More than one person is in the photo. Take a photo of one person only.
result.next.poorquality: The photo is too dark or too blurred. Move closer, face the light, and take it again.

privacy.heading: Privacy & safety model
privacy.intro: TRAYA is built on a simple idea: emergency care needs the minimum necessary information, released only to the people who need it, at the moment they need it.
privacy.principle.minimal.title: Minimal disclosure
privacy.principle.minimal.desc: Public emergency users only ever see treatment-critical facts (blood type, critical allergies/conditions) after a reliable match. Full medical history is never exposed.
privacy.principle.encrypted.title: Encrypted templates
privacy.principle.encrypted.desc: Biometric embeddings are encrypted at rest with app-level encryption. They are decrypted only in-memory during a match and never returned to any client.
privacy.principle.noimages.title: No raw images stored
privacy.principle.noimages.desc: Uploaded photos are processed into embeddings and then discarded. TRAYA does not persist victim photographs.
privacy.principle.consent.title: Informed consent
privacy.principle.consent.desc: Enrollment requires an explicit, revocable biometric consent. Withdrawing it disables face matching for that account.
privacy.principle.human.title: Human confirmation
privacy.principle.human.desc: Ambiguous matches are held for a human responder to review and confirm. The system refuses to assert identity it is not confident about.
privacy.principle.audit.title: Full audit trail
privacy.principle.audit.desc: Every access to medical data, every confirmation, and every rate-limit event is recorded in an immutable audit log.
privacy.roles.title: Role-based access
privacy.role.public.label: Public
privacy.role.public.desc: can start an emergency session and capture a photo; sees only the match result and a public medical summary.
privacy.role.registered.label: Registered user
privacy.role.registered.desc: their own profile, consents and contact details.
privacy.role.responder.label: Responder
privacy.role.responder.desc: can confirm identities and view the responder profile (treatment notes, visible features, contacts).
privacy.role.auditor.label: Auditor
privacy.role.auditor.desc: read-only access to the audit log.
privacy.role.admin.label: Admin
privacy.role.admin.desc: platform configuration, user management and hospital registry.
privacy.demo: This prototype operates exclusively on synthetic demo data. It demonstrates the workflows and controls of the production platform.
